text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Sent my traditional shinme outfit to the cleaners,
and it came back looking sparkling clean!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "You betcha! While we're at it, let's head to the nearby shrine and get a blessing on this sacred horse outfit."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Trainer, someone beat us to it.
Who's that kid...?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... Maybe I went a bit too far.
But~... it's kinda hard to say sorry~.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
I'll ask the gods to help us make up...
Though I wonder if they'd even listen to a wish like this...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aha, looks like you got into
a fight with someone.
choice_data_list: Yeah... If only I could lend a hand.
Yeah... If only I could lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. In that case, this Inari One
will gladly lend a helping hand!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "...Rather than roll up my sleeves, I'm putting something on instead. Perfect fit!"
And so, Inari One busied herself rummaging around behind the shrine—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
O youth. Didst thou summon me?
Indeed, for I amâ

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I am the incarnation of the Inari guarding this shrine! I shall lend thee my power.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
An incarnation of Inari... Y-You don't mean a deity!?
U-Um... I...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: I got into a fight with a friend, and, um...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see...
And so, what is it that thou dost wish to do?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Our friendship with that guy... I mean,
with that person.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Um~... they were in the wrong too,
but it was kinda my fault as well. So...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
If only both of them could apologize and make up.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, splendid.
Well then... looks like you've already got your answer, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
First, apologize to them yourself.
Do that, and they'll be honest with you too.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Me first...?
Will they listen to me, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you'll be fine. Go knock 'em dead.
I'm giving you my personal seal of approval.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, if God says so.
Thank you!
The boy clenched his fist tightly and walked away.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"So, with all that in mind, what do you think,
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heheh, I'm just copying what was done for me back when I was a squirt, though.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that was... back when
I'd just started racing...

text_block_list.name: Young Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here! Ain't you always the one
who starts pickin' a fight first?!

text_block_list.name: Friend Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who told me
to come at you with everything, Inari!

—Whoa, whoa! Stop fighting!
Anyone who wants to fight gets this...

text_block_list.name: Fox Mask
text_block_list.text: The Fox Mask won't let you get away with this!

text_block_list.name: Young Inari One
text_block_list.text:
A fox... mask?!
An incarnation of the Fox Deity?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The Fox Mask made us spit out what we really wanted to say
and helped us make up, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I was just imitating that, is all. Hahaha.
choice_data_list: That fox mask is... a real god?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
No way. There's no way that's true.
That fox mask is...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The master who taught us how to race.
Yeah... God is always...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Right by our side. And when we lose our way, gives us a good, hard smack on the back.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...That said, pretending to be a god
on shrine grounds might be
going a bit too far.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, time to head home while making sure I don't get struck by divine retribution.
And just as I was about to leave the shrine—
(Vrrrooom)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what? What in the world is this...?
...Where am I?
(Clang!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh, that just now was...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"There was a strange light just now...
Did a fox... bewitch me or something?
I feel like my body's gotten a bit lighter, somehow."
Afterward, as if she had gained some sort of supernatural power, Inari One grew a little stronger.
(Caw, caw...)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nothing bad happened on the way
back after all. And on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
And look at that gorgeous sunset. This might just be...
a little reward from God.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!?
(Rumble rumble rumble...!)
With that—! Inari One slipped on the stairs on her way back and tumbled all the way down!
I hurriedly rushed down the stairs...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you bet your bottom dollar, plain as day.
But...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
My nice outfit got dirty again, dammit.
Man, playing pretend god is really not worth the hassle.
Still, if Inari One taking that divine punishment saved the boy, let's believe it was worth it.
